
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /undo                                      │
  │  Undo File Changes                          │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Restore files to their state before the last agent edit.

  Usage:
    /undo
    /undo list

  Details:
    Before the agent writes, edits, renames, patches, or deletes a
    file, RadSim snapshots it. /undo restores the most recent
    checkpoint: rewritten files get their old content back, and
    files that did not exist before are removed.
    
    Covers write_file, replace_in_file, delete_file, rename_file,
    multi_edit, and apply_patch. Keeps the last 20 checkpoints per
    project; files over 5 MB are recorded but not snapshotted.

  Examples:
    $ /undo
    $ /undo list

  Tips:
    Tip: Run /undo repeatedly to step further back.

  Related: /show
